topic_title: How Alcohol and Other Drugs Affect Driving Ability
prompt: Which method is scientifically proven to lower a driver's blood alcohol concentration and sober them up?

options.text: Only time allows the liver to metabolize and remove alcohol from bloodstream
Drinking multiple cups of caffeinated black espresso coffee beverages
Taking a freezing cold shower and splashing ice water on the face and neck
Consuming greasy high-carbohydrate fast foods immediately before driving
